name: feat.daggerheart-domain-card-summon-horror-feature
description:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. Ona success, spend a Hope to call forth an otherworldly creature to attack them and deal d10 magic damage using your Proficiency. The target must succeed on a Reaction Roll (12) to steel themselves from the horror or mark 1d4 Stress.

After making the attack, the creature dissipates.
